meta.name: nanoresearch-ideation
meta.description: Search academic literature and generate research hypotheses

copy.tagline: 搜索学术文献并生成研究假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从学术文献中提炼新的研究方向
copy.tagline_en: Search academic literature and generate research hypotheses
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to derive new research directions from academic papers

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能搜索 arXiv 和 Semantic Scholar 上的学术论文，分析研究空白，并生成 2-4 个新颖的研究假设，最后选出最有潜力的一个并说明理由。
howto.when: 当你提出一个研究主题或问题，需要查找相关文献并生成新假设时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索关于量子点太阳能电池的最新论文，并生成新研究方向。
say.note: Claude 会检索文献并给出假设。

say.text: 分析石墨烯在生物传感器中的研究空白，提出创新假设。
say.note: Claude 会进行差距分析并生成假设。

howto.what_en: Claude can search arXiv and Semantic Scholar for academic papers, analyze research gaps, generate 2-4 novel hypotheses, and select the most promising one with justification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a research topic or question to investigate, requiring literature search and hypothesis generation.

say_en.text: Search for latest papers on quantum dot solar cells and generate new research directions.
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve papers and propose hypotheses.

say_en.text: Analyze research gaps in graphene biosensors and propose innovative hypotheses.
say_en.note: Claude will perform gap analysis and generate hypotheses.
